title: Operative Decision ref C25-0026 2025 CM04 GRANIT DE LA MURE (SCHOONBROODT-DE-AZEVEDO )
text:
OPERATIVE DECISION of the FEI TRIBUNAL
dated 13 February 2026
in the matter of
Ms Celine Schoonbroodt-de Azevedo (PR; Ref. C25-0026)
(FEI Case number: 2025/CM04 GRANIT DE LA MURE)
I. Composition of the FEI Tribunal Hearing Panel:
Ms Diane Pitts (USA), one-member panel
II. Applicable Statutes and Regulations:
▪ Statutes 25th edition, effective 21 November 2023 (“Statutes”).
▪ General Regulations, 24th edition, updates effective 1 January 2025 (“GRs”).
▪ Equine Anti-Doping and Controlled Medication Regulations, 4th edition,
effective 1 January 2025 (“EADCMRs”).
▪ Internal Regulations of the FEI Tribunal, 4th Edition, 2 February 2025 (“IRs”).
▪ FEI’s 2025 Equine Prohibited Substances List (Equine Prohibited List)
1

III. The Decision
1. The Panel makes the following decision and imposes the following sanctions in
accordance with Article 164.11 of the GRs and Article 10 of the ECM Rules:
a) Ms Celine Schoonbroodt-de Azevedo violated Article 2.1 of the ECM Rules.
b) Ms Celine Schoonbroodt-de Azevedo is suspended for a period of six (6)
months. The period of the Ineligibility will be effective from the date of
notification of this decision.
c) The results of the PR and Horse combination at the Event are disqualified,
and the medals, points, prize money, etc. won at the Event are forfeited,
pursuant to Article 9 and 10.1.2 of the ECM Rules.
d) No fine is imposed on Ms Celine Schoonbroodt-de Azevedo.
e) Each Party will bear its own legal costs.
f) Ms Celine Schoonbroodt-de Azevedo is ordered to pay one thousand Swiss
francs (1’000 CHF) to the FEI as costs of the B Sample analysis.
2. Ms Celine Schoonbroodt-de Azevedo, the Belgian NF and the FEI will be notified
this Decision.
3. Ms Celine Schoonbroodt-de Azevedo may not, during the period of Ineligibility,
participate in any capacity in a Competition or activity that is authorised or
organised by the FEI or any National Federation or be present at an event (other
than as a spectator) that is authorized or organised by the FEI or any National
Federation, or participate in any capacity in Competitions authorised or organized
by any international or national-level event organisation (Article 10.13.1 of the ECM
Rules).
4. If Ms Celine Schoonbroodt-de Azevedo violates any of the conditions in the
previous paragraph during the period of Ineligibility, the results of any such
participation will be disqualified and a new period of Ineligibility equal in length up
to the original period of Ineligibility will be added to the end of the original period
of Ineligibility. In addition, further sanctions may be imposed if appropriate (Article
10.13.3 of the ECM Rules).
5. According to Article 170 of the GRs, this Tribunal Decision is effective from the day
of written notification to the persons and bodies concerned.
2

IV. Legal Action
1) Pursuant to Article 39.4 of the Internal Regulations of the FEI Tribunal, the
Panel has decided to communicate the operative part of the Decision to the
Parties, prior to issuing the Reasoned Decision. The Decision shall be
enforceable from such notification of the operative part.
2) In accordance with Article 40.2 of the Internal Regulations of the FEI Tribunal,
the time to Appeal shall not begin to run until receipt of the written, reasoned
Decision. The reasoned Decision will be remitted as soon as possible.
3) According to Articles 162.1 (b) and 162.7 of the FEI General Regulations, this
Decision, in its reasoned form, may be appealed to the Court of Arbitration
for Sport (CAS) by the persons and within the terms set forth in the
applicable rules.
DECISION TO BE FORWARDED TO:
a. The Parties: Yes
b. Any other: No
FOR THE TRIBUNAL
_________________________________________________________________
Ms Diane Pitts (USA), Sole Panel Member
